title: Carnitine functions as an enhancer of NRF2 to inhibit osteoclastogenesis via regulating macrophage polarization in osteoporosis.
authors: Yang, Tao; Liu, Shijie; Ma, Haiwei; Lai, Hehuan; Wang, Chengdi; Ni, Kainan; Lu, Yahong; Li, Weiqing; Hu, Xingyu; Zhou, Zhiguo; Lou, Chao; He, Dengwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肉碱通过抑制Keap1-Nrf2互作增强NRF2功能以调控巨噬细胞极化和破骨细胞生成，涉及分子对接分析，但核心是代谢与炎症调控，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: Osteoporosis, which manifests as reduced bone mass and deteriorated bone quality, is common in the elderly population. It is characterized by persistent elevation of macrophage-associated inflammation and active osteoclast bone resorption. Currently, the roles of intracellular metabolism in regulating these processes remain unclear. In this study, we initially performed bioinformatics analysis and observed a significant increase in the proportion of M1 macrophages in bone marrow with aging. Further metabolomics analysis demonstrated a notable reduction in the expression of carnitine metabolites in aged macrophages, while carnitine was not detected in osteoclasts. During the differentiation process, osteoclasts took up carnitine synthesized by macrophages to regulate their own activity. Mechanistically, carnitine enhanced the function of Nrf2 by inhibiting the Keap1-Nrf2 interaction, reducing the proteasome-dependent ubiquitination and degradation of Nrf2. In silico molecular ligand docking analysis of the interaction between carnitine and Keap1 showed that carnitine binds to Keap1 to stabilize Nrf2 and enhance its function. In this study, we found that the decrease in carnitine levels in aging macrophages causes overactivation of osteoclasts, ultimately leading to osteoporosis. A decrease in serum carnitine levels in patients with osteoporosis was found to have good diagnostic and predictive value. Moreover, supplementation with carnitine was shown to be effective in the treatment of osteoporosis.
abstract_zh: 骨质疏松症表现为骨量减少和骨质量下降，在老年人群中常见。其特征是巨噬细胞相关炎症持续升高和破骨细胞骨吸收活跃。目前，细胞内代谢在调控这些过程中的作用仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们首先进行了生物信息学分析，观察到随着衰老，骨髓中M1巨噬细胞比例显著增加。进一步的代谢组学分析显示，衰老巨噬细胞中肉碱代谢物表达显著减少，而破骨细胞中未检测到肉碱。在分化过程中，破骨细胞摄取由巨噬细胞合成的肉碱以调节自身活性。机制上，肉碱通过抑制Keap1-Nrf2相互作用，减少蛋白酶体依赖性泛素化和Nrf2降解，从而增强Nrf2功能。对肉碱与Keap1相互作用的计算机分子配体对接分析显示，肉碱与Keap1结合以稳定Nrf2并增强其功能。在本研究中，我们发现衰老巨噬细胞中肉碱水平下降导致破骨细胞过度激活，最终引发骨质疏松症。骨质疏松症患者血清肉碱水平降低被发现具有良好的诊断和预测价值。此外，补充肉碱被证明对治疗骨质疏松症有效。
